description: This header defines the IGuide interface within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace, providing an abstraction for guide-related functionalities such as channel and program retrieval, parental controls, and notifications.

classes.name: IGuide
classes.description: Interface for guide control, including retrieving channel and program info, parental controls, and event notifications.

classes.name: IGuide::INotification
classes.description: Nested interface for receiving guide-related notifications such as broadcast, alerts, and parental control changes.

methods.name: StartParser
methods.description: Starts parsing guide data with a given shell interface.

methods.name: GetChannels
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available channels.

methods.name: GetPrograms
methods.description: Retrieves the list of current programs.

methods.name: GetCurrentProgram
methods.description: Gets information about the current program for a specified channel.

methods.name: GetAudioLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves available audio languages for a given program or channel.

methods.name: IsParentalControlled
methods.description: Checks if parental control is enabled.

methods.name: SetParentalLock
methods.description: Locks or unlocks parental control on a specific channel or program.

methods.name: IsParentalLocked
methods.description: Checks whether a specific channel or program is parental locked.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification handler for guide events.

ctags.name: IGuide
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL IGuide : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/

ctags.name: INotification
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL INotification : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
